purpose: Runs the real transcription on a made video and checks the captions file beside the transcript, cue by cue, with nothing burned into the video.
title: A captions file beside the transcript

testCases.description: a captions file beside the transcript of a made video, one numbered cue a phrase with its own times and words, short and hour-long, nothing burned in
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/video-helpers.test.js::a captions file (.srt) from the same pass is kept beside the transcript of the owner's own video, one numbered cue a phrase with the phrase's own times and words, for a short video and an hour's, and nothing is burned into the video, which is left as it was
